newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs pressured, seen sliding to 134.85.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs pressured, seen sliding to 134.85.

text.p: September BTPs face a further day under pressure on Wednesday and will target 134.85 on the downside, a projection from the recently formed double top, technical analysts said.
Any move to the upside will likely be capped by 136.00 as the soggy market struggles to make much headway, they added.
"The market is still weak and is looking to reach 134.85,90, the projection from the double top," said one analyst at an Italian bank in London.
He said moderate support before that came in at 135.36,33, then 135.20.
By 0745 GMT, September BTPs were down 12 basis points at 135.42, off their early low of 135.38

"Further weakness and slight underperformance is expected," said the analyst. "An eventual bounce should see 136.00 as an upper boundary -- only a close above this level would negate the double top formation."
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell technical analyst Elizabeth Miller also noted the double top on daily charts. "The market will head down towards the target of that which is at 134.85," she said.
But initially, the contract must push down through Tuesday's low at 135.36, Miller added.
She said a move through there would bump into first support at 135.09, the 24 percent retracement of the move from 128.60 on May 30 to 137.10 on July 14.
To the upside, Miller said 135.77 would act as first resistance, followed by 136.02, a retracement level from 30 minute charts.
By 0800 GMT, September Eurolira was down three basis points at 93.31.
